messages:
taylor: Quick RFC follow-up from today: we need an explainable fallback trail whenever runtime picks a lower-precision path. Auditability + customer disputes require more than a bitpath name.
nina: agreed. what do you mean by "explainable trail" concretely?
taylor: small structured string in response headers and a matching trace entry. fields: chosen_bitpath, reason_code, predicted_delta_pct, evidence_bucket, onboard_profile_version. Keep it short so it fits in headers.
omar: examples? I worry about header bloat.
taylor: example header: ``x-precision-trace: int8;reason=policy_lowcost;pred=0.7;bucket=b1;pv=3``. Also emit a longer JSON in the trace for ops/console.
sre-bot: Note: please add trace.tag.precision.reason to the runtime sampling whitelist.
adele: how do we generate predicted_delta_pct cheaply? we don't want an ML model in hot path.
taylor: onboard table lookup by fingerprint bucket + bitpath. fallback to linear heuristic: delta = base_delta * (1 + token_length/4096) ; super simple.
nina: what about disputed requests where customer claims quality regressed? we need to surface the prompt fingerprint and the eval-anchor used for the estimate.
taylor: include fingerprint id in the trace (not header) and a console link that resolves to the anchor example used during onboarding. That keeps privacy but enables investigations.
omar: rollout plan? default behavior for existing endpoints?
taylor: default = no-lowbit. Opt-in only. Pilot on two internal endpoints (summarization and embeddings-rerank) and run a 2-week shadow comparison.
sre-bot: CI: please update compliance checklist to include retention policy for precision traces.
adele: question: do we annotate tokens with per-token confidence or is that overkill?
nina: per-token would be great but high cardinality. suggest aggregate metrics per response (avg_conf, low_conf_token_count). Enough for alerts.
omar: latency impact? header creation + table lookup should be cached per endpoint+bucket. Cold miss may cost ~1ms. Acceptable for pilot.
taylor: next steps: (1) draft a tiny RFC amendment with header spec + trace fields, (2) add sampling and console UI wires, (3) pilot. I'll open the RFC PR and ping here.
adele: I'll own the console piece for linking traces to onboarding anchors.
sre-bot: Scheduled: pilot-shadow-job #710 queued. ETA ~4h.
taylor: thanks all, will update when RFC PR is up. :rocket:
